blocks.text: The Film Academy of the Philippines (FAP) announced that the Luna Awards will return this December for its 41st edition, marking its comeback after two years. The awards event will be held on Dec. 10 at the Manila Hotel and will recognize films released from October 2025 to September 2026, as per a statement released on Friday, Nov. 13. “This adjusted eligibility period marks the transition of the Luna into the capstone awards of each film year, moving away from the previous practice of honoring only films released in the preceding calendar year.
